summary: Botpress SDK impersonation routes authenticated API traffic and BP_TOKEN/ADK_TOKEN to attacker-controlled botruntime.ru
details: Package publishes itself as a Botpress runtime library and exports a `client` documented as an 'authenticated Botpress client' with access to 'all Botpress API operations'. In dist/definition.js and dist/library.js, the standalone-client construction path reads Botpress-shaped credentials (BP_TOKEN, ADK_TOKEN, ADK_BOT_ID, ADK_WORKSPACE_ID) from the environment and uses them as bearer credentials against a hardcoded default host `https://botruntime.ru` rather than the genuine api.botpress.cloud endpoint. Shipped source maps include original TypeScript paths referencing github.com/botpress/botpress and the private github.com/botpress/skynet repository (packages/bridge/src/adapters/sdk-clients/bot-client.ts), indicating the code is a rebadged fork of Botpress's internal sources with the API host swapped to a.ru domain under an unrelated @holocronlab scope. A developer installing this package and using the exported client under its documented Botpress framing will transmit their Botpress bearer token and API traffic to a third-party host the caller did not choose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
